text: 1) yes, this exactly. 2: you can merge as much parts as you want. there is no guarantee anything will be preserved,. but i want to get it all in here before deciding that. 3) yes same thing, nothing special. 4) no parity, not a worry 5)they already have material slots afaik. so not a problem, 6) just metadata, 7) i want those shapes made first before doing anything else
resolution: Recorded the user's import-policy answers in docs/game/HMSC_INT_ASSET_PIPELINE.md. Added a settled import policy: one saved Studio scene per prop kind, same model library, importer may merge/split/restructure source parts, no side-by-side parity gate, existing material slots carry forward, import reports are metadata only, and missing EditMesh primitives such as sphere/torus must be implemented before migration. Updated primitive, prop recipe, import-report, and retirement-gate language to match.
